offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures insulated panels, insulation boards, roofing and waterproofing, daylighting and ventilation, facades and data center and cold-chain related building products. Sells mainly to contractors, builders and developers for commercial, industrial and residential buildings, through its own plants worldwide.

primary_products.value: insulated metal panels; rigid insulation boards; roof and waterproofing membranes; facade and cladding systems; daylighting and smoke ventilation systems

customer_segment.value: B2B: building contractors, installers, developers, architects, builders' merchants, industrial and data center owners

end_markets.value: non-residential construction; residential construction; data centers; cold storage and food logistics; building renovation

revenue_model.value: product sales: building envelope and insulation products sold to contractors and merchants

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures panels and insulation from chemicals, steel and other raw materials, sold to contractors and merchants

geography_served.value: global: Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific, Middle East and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: insulated panels, insulation boards, light and air, water and energy, and data and flooring products

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales to contractors, developers and large project customers; distributors / dealers: builders' merchants and distributors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: building codes, fire safety standards and environmental rules for construction materials and manufacturing

notes: Segment names and product mix from general knowledge; the water and energy line (tanks, renewable products) may be partly out of date. Services are minor, so primary_services is not_applicable.
